material.description: js/client/widgets.js:34 #ui-modal host created in hostFor; js/client/play.html:117 legacy #lobby. Symptom: focus stays on the canvas behind the lobby, Tab walks hidden HUD, assistive tech is not told a dialog opened. Acceptance: modal host gets role=dialog, aria-labelledby the panel title, focus moves in on open and returns on close; background inert. Witness: open lobby, document.activeElement inside #ui-modal.

notes.note: edit published; witness needs a browser look (a11y tree / focus / 390px screenshot), left open
